- Black walls with gray dots
- Purple progress bar at bottom

            initial_colors[c] = 0
        initial_colors[c] += 1
    print(f"Initial colors: {initial_colors}")
    
    # Check initial player position

        if n['color'] == 'b':
            rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            print(f"Initial player: row {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, col {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
